name: icon-buttons
title: Icon Buttons
description: Four icon buttons, each with its own reaction and a tooltip that names it: the bell rings and its badge counts down, the gear turns a quarter with a ratchet, the mic goes live with a pulsing ring, the pin presses in upright
docs: Docs: https://notchset.dev/components/icon-buttons · Agent prompt: https://notchset.dev/md/icon-buttons.md · For the full notchset look, also add @notchset/notchset (tokens and fonts). · Needs React 19 and Tailwind CSS v4 (Tailwind 3 projects: upgrade first, see https://notchset.dev/docs/installation).

meta.useWhen: icon button, notification bell, settings gear, mute microphone, pin, toolbar icons, tooltip
